changelog:
Fix: embedded full-page image extraction could produce a cropped-looking cover for PDFs where the first page's image is placed relative to a MediaBox that is offset/larger than the page's own CropBox (seen in some newspaper/imposed PDF exports)
- The full-page-image detection now compares the image's placement against the page's CropBox using intersection-over-union instead of a plain area ratio, so images that only partially overlap the visible page (or extend well beyond it as bleed) correctly fall back to full rasterization instead of being extracted as-is
description: Automatically generates cover thumbnails for PDF files in your Jellyfin library by rendering the first page of each PDF. Supports configurable render resolution (DPI) and thumbnail padding mode.
name: PDF Thumbnails
overview: Generates thumbnail images from the first page of PDF files.
